note: Weekly Google Business Profile posts for Booked Out Solutions, approved by Rickey Nov 12 2026. One a week, in order. Helpful tips, not ads.

posts.text: Free tip for home service owners: answer every Google review, even the short 5-star ones. The next customer reads your replies to see how you treat people. More free tips at getbookedoutsolutions.com.
Got old quotes that never answered? Most aren't a no, people just got busy. A short follow-up on day 2, 7 and 14 brings a lot of them back. Free tips for trade owners at getbookedoutsolutions.com.

Free tip for trade owners: add real photos from your own jobs to your Google profile every month. Before and after shots show the work is real, and fresh photos keep your profile active. More free tips at getbookedoutsolutions.com.
Quick check: does your Google profile list every service you do, with real job photos and current hours? Small fixes there help more people find you. Free guides at getbookedoutsolutions.com.
Slow season? Before spending on ads, reach out to the customers you already have. Many are due for a check-up and would rather call someone they know. Free tips at getbookedoutsolutions.com.
Holiday hours set on your Google profile? If Google says open and nobody answers, that's a lost call. Set special hours ahead of time. More free tips at getbookedoutsolutions.com.

Free tip: ask for the review before you leave the driveway, while the customer is happy. A short text with your review link that same day works far better than waiting a week. More free tips at getbookedoutsolutions.com.
New year tip for trade owners: put every past customer in one simple list. It's the most valuable list you own. Free tips at getbookedoutsolutions.com.
Missed calls are missed jobs. If your phone goes to voicemail during jobs, a fast text back can save the lead. Free tips for home service owners at getbookedoutsolutions.com.
Is your business listed on Apple Maps and Bing too? Both are free and matter more than most owners think. Free guides at getbookedoutsolutions.com.

Free tip: answer the questions you hear on every call (weekends, which towns, free estimates, financing, how soon) on your website and Google profile. People call ready to book. Free tips at getbookedoutsolutions.com.
Train the front-door hello: name, company, "Where would you like me to start?" The first 30 seconds shape the whole visit and the review that follows. More tips at getbookedoutsolutions.com.
Before busy season, update your Google photos and services, clean up the website, and restock the trucks. The work you do now shows up later. Free tips at getbookedoutsolutions.com.
